```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
from seaborn import objects as so
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
import harmonypy as hm
from pyclustree import clustree
```

```{python}
cars = sc.read_h5ad("1_cars_only.h5ad")
```

```{python}
cars.X = cars.layers["counts"].copy()
```

```{python}
sc.pp.normalize_total(cars, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(cars)
cars.layers['logcounts'] = cars.X.copy()
```

```{python}
plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        cars.layers['counts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()

plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        cars.layers['logcounts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()
```

```{python}
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    cars, 
    n_top_genes=2000, 
    flavor="cell_ranger", 
    batch_key='GEX_id', 
    layer = 'logcounts',
    subset = False
)
```

```{python}
cars_hvg = cars[:, cars.var.highly_variable].copy()

sc.pp.regress_out(cars_hvg, ["pct_counts_mt"])
sc.pp.scale(cars_hvg)
sc.pp.pca(cars_hvg)
```

```{python}
cars.obsm["X_pca"] = cars_hvg.obsm["X_pca"]
cars.uns["pca"] = cars_hvg.uns["pca"]
```

```{python}
plt.figure()
sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(cars, n_pcs=50, log=True)
plt.savefig("car_only/Elbow_plot.png", dpi=300)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(cars, n_pcs=18, use_rep="X_pca")
sc.tl.umap(cars, random_state=2026)
```

```{python}
fig = sc.pl.umap(cars, color=["Patient", "Timepoint_bin", "Sort", "Source"], 
wspace=0.2,show=False, size = 1, ncols=2,frameon = False, return_fig = True)
fig.set_size_inches(10, 6)
print(fig.get_size_inches())
fig.savefig("car_only/umap_meta.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close
```

```{python}
    key_added="dea_leiden_res_0.6_filtered",
)
```

```{python}
import celltypist
from celltypist import models

models.download_models(
    force_update=True, 
    model=["Immune_All_High.pkl"]
)
model_immune_high = models.Model.load(model="Immune_All_High.pkl")

models.download_models(
    force_update=True, 
    model=["Immune_All_Low.pkl"]
)
model_immune_low = models.Model.load(model="Immune_All_Low.pkl")

models.download_models(
    force_update=True, 
    model=["COVID19_HumanChallenge_Blood.pkl"]
)
model_covid = models.Model.load(model="COVID19_HumanChallenge_Blood.pkl")
```

```{python}
pred_high = celltypist.annotate(
    cars,
    model="Immune_All_High.pkl"
)

ad_high = pred_high.to_adata(insert_conf=True)

cars.obs["celltypist_high_label"] = ad_high.obs["predicted_labels"]
cars.obs["celltypist_high_score"] = ad_high.obs["conf_score"]

pred_low = celltypist.annotate(
    cars,
    model="Immune_All_Low.pkl"
)

ad_low = pred_low.to_adata(insert_conf=True)

cars.obs["celltypist_low_label"] = ad_low.obs["predicted_labels"]
cars.obs["celltypist_low_score"] = ad_low.obs["conf_score"]

pred_covid = celltypist.annotate(
    cars,
    model="COVID19_HumanChallenge_Blood.pkl"
)

ad_covid = pred_covid.to_adata(insert_conf=True)

cars.obs["celltypist_covid_label"] = ad_covid.obs["predicted_labels"]
cars.obs["celltypist_covid_score"] = ad_covid.obs["conf_score"]
```

```{python}
fig = sc.pl.umap(cars, color=["celltypist_high_label", "celltypist_low_label", "celltypist_covid_label"], 
wspace=1,show=False, size = 1, ncols=3,frameon = False, return_fig = True)
fig.set_size_inches(25, 10)
print(fig.get_size_inches())
fig.savefig("car_only/umap_celltypist.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close
```

```{python}
label_props = cars.obs["celltypist_high_label"].value_counts(normalize=True)

major_labels = label_props[label_props >= 0.05].index

labels = cars.obs["celltypist_high_label"].astype(str)

cars.obs["celltypist_high_label_5pct"] = labels.where(
    labels.isin(major_labels),
    "Other"
)
```

```{python}
label_props = cars.obs["celltypist_low_label"].value_counts(normalize=True)

major_labels = label_props[label_props >= 0.01].index

labels = cars.obs["celltypist_low_label"].astype(str)

cars.obs["celltypist_low_label_1pct"] = labels.where(
    labels.isin(major_labels),
    "Other"
)
```

```{python}
label_props = cars.obs["celltypist_covid_label"].value_counts(normalize=True)

major_labels = label_props[label_props >= 0.05].index

labels = cars.obs["celltypist_covid_label"].astype(str)

cars.obs["celltypist_covid_label_5pct"] = labels.where(
    labels.isin(major_labels),
    "Other"
)
```

```{python}
counts = pd.crosstab(
    cars.obs["leiden_res_0.6"],
    cars.obs["celltypist_covid_label_1pct"]
)
props = counts.div(counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0)
props= props * 100
props.head()
```

```{python}
props = props.reset_index()
props = props.melt(id_vars = "leiden_res_0.6", var_name = "celltype", value_name = "percent")
```

```{python}
p = (
    so.Plot(props, x="leiden_res_0.6", y="percent", color="celltype")
    .scale(color="tab20")
    .add(so.Bar(), so.Stack())
    .theme({
        "axes.facecolor": "w", 
        "axes.edgecolor": "grey"})
    .layout(size=(10,6))
)

p.save("car_only/covid_celltypist_proportions_res_0.6.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
```

```{python}
labels = {
    "0":"CM CD8+ T",
    "1":"Activated CM CD8+ T",
    "2":"CM CD8+ T",
    "3":"Activated Naive/CM T",
    "4":"DN T",
    "5":"Cycling T",
    "6":"DN/CD8+ T",
    "7":"Naive/CM T",
    "8":"Product CD8+ T",
    "9":"GD/CD8+ T",
    "10":"EM CD8+ T",
    "11":"Early EM CD8+ T",
    "12":"DN T",
    "13":"Myeloid contamination",
    "14":"Product Mixed T",
    "15":"GD/CD8+ T",
    "16":"Exhausted/Late EM CD8+ T",
    "17":"Product Mixed T"
}

cars.obs["labels"] = (
    cars.obs["leiden_res_0.6"]
    .map(labels)
    .astype("category")
)
sc.tl.dendrogram(cars, groupby="labels")
```

```{python}
label_palette = {
    "CM CD8+ T":"darkred",
    "Activated CM CD8+ T":"mediumvioletred",
    "DN T":"springgreen",
    "Cycling T":"skyblue",
    "DN/CD8+ T":"forestgreen",
    "Naive/CM T":"deepskyblue",
    "Activated Naive/CM T":"blue",
    "Product CD8+ T":"grey",
    "GD/CD8+ T":"gold",
    "EM CD8+ T":"red",
    "Early EM CD8+ T":"indianred",
    "Myeloid contamination":"tan",
    "Product Mixed T":"black",
    "Exhausted/Late EM CD8+ T":"darkorchid"
}

```

# also saving an object with no gamma/delta and meyloid contamination
# these populations are predominantly found in one patient and g/d don;'' biologically make sense in pseudotime analysis
```{python}

car_subset = cars[~cars.obs["labels"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
car_subset.write_h5ad("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")
```
